name: South Lake Tahoe, CA
summary: Sleeping in a vehicle is prohibited citywide, including on private property. A cooperative parking-lot owner does not change this.
citation: South Lake Tahoe City Code Ch. 4.70 (camping ordinance, effective 2019-06-06) — defines "camp" to include sleeping or preparing to sleep, and expressly extends that to a vehicle parked in a public space, public street, or private property, engine running or not.

name: Reno, NV
